description: Déploiement des réseaux très haut débit sur l'ensemble du territoire national is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Premier ministre. This report presents the various scenarios for the widespread deployment of very high-speed broadband and the necessary investments, and opens up avenues for reflection on the financing arrangements. Its main conclusions: 1. Without public support, only 25 % to 40 % of the population will have very high speed; 2. Coverage: Premier ministre. The portal shows the English title as "Deployment of very high-speed networks throughout the national territory" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Premier ministre. The listing shows 2 download or service links in PDF. The listing shows 2016-02-06 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
